text: The Patriots have discovered something magical at Highmark Stadium: they're the first team to win there, having just upset the Bills 29-26 in a Week 4 thriller that Mike Vrabel is already treating as a season-defining moment for his defending AFC champions. Drake Maye, who stumbled early in the season, orchestrated a clutch game-winning drive and threw three touchdown passes despite coughing up two turnovers, proving he doesn't need perfection when the moments matter most—a performance that's already sparking breathless talk about another AFC East title run, though perhaps we should pump the brakes on declaring a comeback fully baked after one win. The defensive line made a statement by neutralizing Dalton Kincaid, the Bills' red-hot tight end, but the Week 5 matchup with the Raiders looms as a genuine test, since Las Vegas fields a formidable 1-2 tight end combination in Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer that will demand the same disciplined coverage. This rally from 1-3 alongside the Rams and Cowboys joins a handful of stunning Week 4 comebacks that have rewired playoff expectations, though whether New England has truly turned a corner or simply grabbed one essential W remains the more measured question.
